dedupe_keys.name: emergency department discrete event simulation framework for managerial decision making khalifa university

description: A framework combining design thinking and discrete event simulation to analyse and improve the operation of a hospital emergency department, published in 2025 in the Journal of Nursing Management by a Khalifa University team in Abu Dhabi. The simulation is used as a digital twin with a design of experiments to test how resource configurations change key performance indicators such as length of stay, and to expose the resource bottlenecks. A case study reports that targeted changes to nurse staffing and bed management raise productivity and cut length of stay. Coverage: one emergency department; the article cites the Abu Dhabi Department of Health standard for emergency departments. Format and access: an open access article; the model files are not released, and the data are available from the corresponding author on request. Caveats: findings depend on one site's data and cannot be reproduced without a request to the authors. Useful for capacity planning and what-if simulation of emergency department operations in critical facilities; related records are not yet linked.
